## What changes?

## Evidence
- [ ] Original programme / law / vote source linked
- [ ] Quotes are verbatim; page and Markdown references still resolve
- [ ] Stable IDs are preserved
- [ ] No future manifesto matched retroactively to an older law
- [ ] Impact direction is not confused with fulfilment or party votes
- [ ] Review metadata names a human, date and rationale (or stays `proposed`)
- [ ] Negative / inconclusive evidence and legal exceptions considered
- [ ] No credentials or personal data added

For generated data: verify the extraction against the PDF, not only against its generated Markdown.
